entries: While below 50% health, your lifesteal is doubled.
Healing you receive also grants a barrier worth 30% of it (up to 25% of max health).
Gain 1 Defense and 1 Soul Defense per 4 Offense.
Your Offense also counts as SO at half value.
Gain SO equal to 2% of your max health.
Every 1% attack speed above base also grants 1 SO.
Your bonus move speed is added to your damage.
Gain 2 Defense and 2 Soul Defense per 100 max health.
Your magic damage over time keeps ticking 4 more times after it ends, each tick 1/8 of your SO.
Every 3rd attack is a critical strike.
Your marks deal +15% more for every 10% bonus max health you have.
Every 2nd hit on a marked enemy counts as a weapon swap for your marks' tiers.
Your attack speed is halved, but your hits deal 2.5x damage, Offense and SO alike. Your damage over time and returned damage deal 1.25x.
Your attack speed is doubled, but each hit deals half damage. Your on-hit effects keep their full strength.
+30% max health, but your hits can never critically strike.
+15% lifesteal, but no other healing works on you (camp heals included).
Your SO is multiplied by 1.5, but your Wish's cooldown is doubled.
Your second weapon slot is locked. The weapon you hold deals +20% damage and attacks 15% faster.
Your damage over time keeps burning twice as long after a fight breaks off, at 30% less per second.
While unarmed: +40% attack speed (counts toward the cap), and your on-hit effects apply twice.
Damage beyond a kill splashes onto the nearest enemy within 200 u.
Permanently gain 1 max health for every point of damage your blocks prevent (up to +250).
Your blocks slow the attacker by 30% for 1 s.
Each hit has a 15% chance to deal double damage and a 15% chance to deal half.
-30% damage for your first 3 s in a fight, then +35%.
+25% damage to elites and to players above 70% health.
+3% damage for every camp you helped clear this run (up to +24%).
After losing 10% or more of your max health in one hit: +40% move and attack speed for 2 s.
Damage you deal and take is multiplied by 1 / your health fraction (up to 2.5x).
Your damage over time can critically strike (+20% critical strike chance).
Your attacks gain +20% critical strike chance. Plague's damage-over-time ticks cannot crit; instead they deal bonus damage equal to half your current critical strike chance.
Every 3rd hit on the same target applies its on-hit effects twice.
Damage you return to attackers applies your on-hit effects.
Slowed enemies take 12% more damage from you.
+4% damage per hit on the same target, up to 10 stacks; switching targets resets it.
Your first hit on a new target deals +40% damage.
After standing still for 1 s, your next attack has +25% range and damage.
Each hit you land shortens your Wish's cooldown by 1 s (at most 30 s a minute).
Your physical hits make the target bleed for 10% of the hit over 2 s.
Melee attackers take 15% of the damage they deal to you back as physical damage.
Your marks climb their tiers 50% faster.
Healing you receive is 25% stronger (camp heals included).
Your damage over time heals you for 20% of the damage it deals.
+10% damage to players who hold more card power than you.
Once per run, the first time a hit leaves you below 25% health: heal 20% of max health over 1.5 s.
+8% damage to a target that is fighting someone else.
Your execute starts at 60% health instead of 50%; with no execute, +8% damage to targets below 60% health.
Your zone Wish lasts 2 s longer, and an enemy that leaves it is stunned for 2.25 s.
When a marked enemy swaps weapons, your mark climbs two tiers instead of one.
When your mark blocks an enemy's execute, the blocked damage is dealt back to it as true damage.
Freeze the enemy nearest your cursor in place for a moment.
Dissolve into a swarm: enemies lose sight of you and cannot target you.
Judge an enemy: inside the ring it deals less, moves 30% slower, and takes more from you; leaving it stuns. Your mark on it is at full strength. A ring on a convicted enemy is tighter.
Blink toward your cursor, through walls, leaving a burning trail.
